summary: SiTime Corporation filed an 8-K reporting expiration of the HSR Act waiting period for its planned acquisition of timing business assets from Renesas Electronics America. The total consideration is approximately $1.5 billion cash plus 4,130,644 shares of SiTime common stock. No per-share price or premium is disclosed. The board has not issued a new recommendation; this filing updates regulatory clearance. The transaction is financed partly by a $900 million bridge loan from Wells Fargo, though closing is not conditioned on that facility. Remaining conditions include customary representations and warranties. Watch for final closing conditions and potential financing alternatives.
